items.headline: Gale Watch issued November 23 at 1:41PM EST until November 26 at 1:00PM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
12 to 17 ft possible.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Duck to Cape Hatteras.

* WHEN...From Wednesday afternoon through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
